name: Copy traders
summary: Follow Polymarket traders and copy each of their trades on paper, $10 a buy, within limits you set.
description:
Copytrading makes the trades other traders make, as they make them. Polymarket wallets are public, so you can follow anyone: a trader's address is in the link of their profile, polymarket.com/profile/0x….

This workflow copies each trade of the traders you follow, a few seconds after it: $10 for each of their buys, and for a sell, the same share of what it holds copying them. Risk guard keeps the copies within limits: at most $50 in one market and $200 a day, and no buys under 0.05 or over 0.95, where a market is all but decided.

It trades on paper: orders fill against the live order book, out of a paper account of the workflow's own, and spend no real money.

- Fill in the traders to follow, then switch Active on.
- The Trading view shows how it does: each trader's profit and loss, what it holds, and every order.
- To be asked on Telegram before each copy, use Copy traders with approval instead.

nodes.name: Traders to follow
nodes.notes: Starts the workflow with each trade one of your traders makes. Switch a trader off in the table to stop copying them and keep their row.

Works out the order that copies the trade: $10 for a buy, the same share of what it holds for a sell, at their price or at most 2 cents worse. A trade it cannot copy, like a sell of something it never bought, goes out of skipped.
Keeps buys within your limits: $50 in one market, $200 a day, prices from 0.05 to 0.95. A copy over a cap goes ahead smaller; one a limit stops goes out of blocked. Sells always go ahead.
Places the copy on paper, against the live order book: what the book has within the price fills at once, the rest is cancelled. Orders that did not fill go out of missed.
